perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.desc: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.desc: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Nano-Assault
perks.desc: Quicksilver nanites that attach to the wielder charge the blade. [Alternate Weapon Action]  when fully charged to overclock the attached nanites, enhancing the blade's offensive capabilities. Light attacks deal increased damage to targets; fully charged Heavy attacks create a flaming Quicksilver swarm-nado.

perks.name: Tenacious Handle
perks.desc: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain greatly increased damage resistance from being in combat for an extended duration.

perks.name: Rampager's Handle
perks.desc: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain moderately increased damage resistance from being in combat for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Unyielding Handle
perks.desc: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain damage resistance from being in combat for a short duration.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs Refit
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes Refit
perks.desc: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Burning Ambition Refit
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION
perks.desc: Quicksilver nanites grant more health the greater your stacks of Nano-Assault are. Taking damage while Nano-Assault is active has the chance to generate nanites nearby.
